title: I partnered with @OpenAI to show how I use Codex in the new ChatGPT desktop app 👀 #ChatGPT_Partner
description:
Now that building is becoming so easy…

Choosing what to build is becoming the hard part, So here's my new workflow I've set up with Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app #ad

In one prompt I can ask Codex to consolidate all of my feedback across my feedback board, the app store, and customer emails, and start ranking things in order of ROI 👀

And then when I'm ready I can have it start a new thread and work on the feature 

This is my new workflow when it comes to building a roadmap and I don't know how I was doing it before this 😮‍💨

@OpenAI  #ChatGPT_Partner
